subject.title: [Bug]: mimo-v2.5 / mimo-v2.5-pro thinking content leaked into text reply causing severe repetition

question: Should this be fixed as a MiMo provider/runtime duplicate-output sanitizer now, or folded into the broader visible-reasoning security work before implementation?
rationale: The source gap is concrete, but the fix changes hidden-reasoning visibility behavior and needs a maintainer-owned boundary decision plus live MiMo payload proof.

options.title: Provider sanitizer now
options.body: Implement a narrow MiMo v2.5/v2.5-pro sanitizer at the provider or stream wrapper boundary, preserving non-duplicated final text and proving it with live MiMo output.

options.title: Fold into broader security tracker
options.body: Route this through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88233 or a broader visible-reasoning item if maintainers want one shared sanitizer policy across channels and providers.

options.title: Wait for provider clarification
options.body: Leave this open until Xiaomi/OpenAI-compatible payload behavior is confirmed externally, accepting continued leakage risk for affected users.

recommendation.title: Provider sanitizer now
recommendation.body: Implement a narrow MiMo v2.5/v2.5-pro sanitizer at the provider or stream wrapper boundary, preserving non-duplicated final text and proving it with live MiMo output.

likelyOwner.reason: The MiMo v2.5/v2.5-pro reasoning replay path is the closest merged history to the reported behavior.
